MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Master Services Agreement is made and entered into on 03/04/2024 by and
between Globex Corporation ("Provider") and Initech Industries ("Customer").

**1. Scope of Services**

Provider shall perform the services described in each Statement of Work.

**2. Fees and Payment**

Customer shall pay Provider the fees set forth in the applicable Statement of
Work. Total contract value shall not exceed $250,000.

**3. Term and Termination**

The initial term of this Agreement is three (3) years. Either party may
terminate for convenience upon thirty (30) days' written notice.

**4. Limitation of Liability**

Provider's aggregate liability shall not exceed the fees paid in the prior
twelve months.

**5. Governing Law**

This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of California.
